biography.plain_text: Gennady Ayvazyan is a Russian businessman whose career centres on the coal industry. A Military University graduate, he led the Austrian trader Krutrade from 2002 and became one of its beneficial owners. His later holdings include a substantial minority stake in Resource, a coal producer operating in Russia's Kuzbass region.

confidence.reason: The selected facts are supported by contemporary reporting, direct testimony and corporate records; conflicting promotional narratives are excluded.

long_biography.plain_text:
Gennady Ayvazyan's work at Krutrade placed him on the export side of Russia's coal business. The Austrian company marketed Kuzbassrazrezugol's output abroad, while the mining company sold its coal within Russia. This division made the trader an important profit centre in the group, distinct from the extraction businesses supplying it.

Boxing also drew his sustained involvement. He had trained seriously as a young man and supported Igor Vysotsky's boxing club. In 2005 he joined the Russian Boxing Federation as a vice-president, representing Kuzbassrazrezugol. Soon after his appointment, he proposed changes to the federation's working structure as it prepared to host the World Cup in Moscow.
